units.source_text: 吟罢禁不住哭泣起来，这也是难怪的。

en.t: After finishing the poem, she could not help beginning to weep, and that was only natural.

units.source_text: 她回想过去多年来夫妇之谊，觉得今朝一旦抛舍，

en.t: She thought back on the bond of husband and wife that had lasted for so many years, and felt that to cast it away all at once that morning,

units.source_text: 凭仗了这不甚可靠的因缘而重新回到曾经厌弃的京都，实在不是妥善之计。

en.t: and to return to the capital she had once detested on the strength of such an unreliable connection, was truly no sound plan.
